svg.title: Steward Architecture
svg.desc: Top: the shared/ single source is rendered by two builders into the ZCode / MiniMax / DSH host bundles, each installed separately. Bottom: at runtime the lead agent acts as Tech Lead through intake, planning, the approval gate, DAG-driven implementation and quality gates, dispatching 7 specialist roles, with the artifact bus and local gate scripts running throughout.
svg.text: One source builds three host bundles; the Tech Lead dispatches a task DAG
single source of truth · never hand-edit generated files · --check catches drift
frontmatter · dispatch · model tables · browser ops
--check blocks hand edits and un-rebuilt drift
Each host is developed, tested and updated independently
Runtime: the lead agent is the Tech Lead
the lead owns delivery · subagent output is checked · substandard work goes back
Slash commands are ZCode's; MiniMax / DSH trigger by natural language (DSH roster: /steward-roster)
S: lead writes a mini plan
the task is the dispatch unit, not a role slot · DSH injects charters, no Agent Presets
every handoff is a file · every claim needs real output
all handoffs go through files, not long prose in prompts
local Node scripts, no CI; a non-zero exit code is a failure
resume · stop after 2 same errors · budget
principles: small changes skip the full team · gates never downgrade · failures reported as-is · git untouched by default
host surfaces: ZCode commands · MiniMax GenUI board · DSH right-sidebar board
